what: Multi-line text is revealed line by line, wiping from left to right (.7s, .22s apart), like a handwritten quote being written out. data-fx-line-wipe="steps: 14" With steps like this, the reveal breaks into stairs and prints like a hatched plate

options.stagger: Line spacing, default .22 (.35 for the hatched type)
options.on: On load it plays once right after attaching without waiting for scroll — a reference site’s hero two-line title (duration 2 · stagger .3 · ease 0.25,0.1,0.25,1)
options.ease: Curve (four Bezier values or a GSAP name), default power1.inOut — Brand uses CSS ease (0.25,0.1,0.25,1)

from.where: index.html .bq__line (seven handwritten quote lines) · about.html .ab-big__line (hatched panel, three lines, steps(14) 1.1s, .35s stagger)
index.html .tk-mv__hl (two-line title over the hero photo — on: load · 2s ease · second line .3s later)
